Transparency & control

Publisher, support & grievances

TruthLens India is published and operated by Pushpraj singh prashant, an independent individual publisher.

Public support, privacy and grievance contact: begoneraj@gmail.com.

Send a concern

For an inaccurate claim, missing attribution, harmful content, copyright concern or privacy request, email the contact above. Include the article title or ID, the issue, relevant source links and the action you are requesting. Do not include passwords, OTPs or unnecessary sensitive information.

We aim to acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 days, or explain any delay. Applicable statutory timelines take precedence. This is an operational target, not a claim that every statutory category applies to this service.

Corrections and lawful requests

Reports are reviewed against the linked evidence. Appropriate corrections, attribution changes or removal may follow. Rights holders should identify the protected work and the allegedly infringing item. Lawful requests are reviewed for authenticity and applicable obligations.
